# Solborne & Co.

Solborne is a brand of KISNO PROPTY LLP, Kolkata, India. It helps businesses create a clear first website. The current free V1 is a responsive one-page website plus editable HTML source and README, after processing, private review and release. Hosting, domains, maintenance and additional services are separate. Automated AI delivery and seven-day preview expiry are not claimed as live.
